title: WSS registrations and payments
description: Registrations, orders and revenue of one edition, from the backend and payment databases.

list.name: event
list.label: Edition
list.query: SELECT 'WSS ' || "order" AS __text, id AS __value FROM core_event ORDER BY "order" DESC
list.definition: SELECT 'WSS ' || "order" AS __text, id AS __value FROM core_event ORDER BY "order" DESC

panels.title: Edition overview (whole edition, ignores the time range)
Registrations
panels.description: Participations in any plan of the edition.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*)
FROM participant_participation pp
JOIN participant_participationplan pl ON pl.id = pp.plan_id
WHERE pl.event_id = ${event}

panels.title: Participants
panels.description: Distinct people with at least one participation.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(DISTINCT pp.participant_id)
FROM participant_participation pp
JOIN participant_participationplan pl ON pl.id = pp.plan_id
WHERE pl.event_id = ${event}

SELECT count(*)
FROM payment_paymentrequest pr
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM payment_paymentrequest_plans prp
  JOIN participant_participationplan pl ON pl.id = prp.participationplan_id
  WHERE prp.paymentrequest_id = pr.id AND pl.event_id = ${event}
)
AND pr.status = 'paid'

panels.title: Real income in range (Toman)
panels.description: Money actually received for this edition: net of discounts, successful gateway payments inside the selected time range. Stored in Rial, shown in Toman. See the Income section for the full breakdown.

targets.rawSql:
WITH edition_orders AS (
  SELECT pr.order_id AS oid
  FROM payment_paymentrequest pr
  JOIN payment_paymentrequest_plans prp ON prp.paymentrequest_id = pr.id
  JOIN participant_participationplan pl ON pl.id = prp.participationplan_id
  WHERE pl.event_id = ${event}
  GROUP BY pr.order_id
  UNION
  SELECT g.order_id
  FROM payment_grouppaymentrequest g
  JOIN participant_participationplan pl ON pl.id = g.plan_id
  WHERE pl.event_id = ${event}
),
inc AS (
  SELECT p.*
  FROM payment_remote.payments p
  JOIN edition_orders o ON o.oid = p.order_id::text
)
SELECT coalesce(sum(to_pay_amount), 0) / 10 AS income
FROM inc
WHERE payment_status = 3 -- success
AND $__timeFilter(verified_at)

panels.title: Over time (follows the time range, Tehran days)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('day', pp.date AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tehran') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tehran' AS time, count(*) AS registrations
FROM participant_participation pp
JOIN participant_participationplan pl ON pl.id = pp.plan_id
WHERE pl.event_id = ${event}
AND $__timeFilter(pp.date)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('day', pr.timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tehran') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tehran' AS time, pr.status AS metric, count(*) AS orders
FROM payment_paymentrequest pr
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM payment_paymentrequest_plans prp
  JOIN participant_participationplan pl ON pl.id = prp.participationplan_id
  WHERE prp.paymentrequest_id = pr.id AND pl.event_id = ${event}
)
AND $__timeFilter(pr.timestamp)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

  WHERE pl.event_id = ${event}

inc AS (

panels.title: New accounts per day
panels.description: Sign-ups on the site, all editions.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('day', date_joined AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tehran') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tehran' AS time, count(*) AS accounts
FROM auth_user
WHERE $__timeFilter(date_joined)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT pl.id, pl.kind,
  coalesce(w.name, sc.course_name, '') AS workshop_or_course,
  m.name AS attendance,
  pl.price / 10 AS price_toman,
  pl.capacity,
  count(pp.id) AS registered,
  CASE WHEN pl.capacity > 0 THEN count(pp.id)::float / pl.capacity END AS fill,
  pl.is_open
FROM participant_participationplan pl
LEFT JOIN core_workshop w ON w.id = pl.workshop_id
LEFT JOIN spotplayer_spotplayercourse sc ON sc.id = pl.spotplayer_course_id
LEFT JOIN participant_modeofattendance m ON m.id = pl.mode_of_attendance_id
LEFT JOIN participant_participation pp ON pp.plan_id = pl.id
WHERE pl.event_id = ${event}
GROUP BY pl.id, w.name, sc.course_name, m.name
ORDER BY registered DESC

SELECT coalesce(nullif(trim(i.university), ''), '(not given)') AS university, count(*) AS count
FROM participant_participation pp
JOIN participant_participationplan pl ON pl.id = pp.plan_id
JOIN participant_participant p ON p.id = pp.participant_id
JOIN participant_participantinfo i ON i.id = coalesce(pp.info_id, p.info_id)
WHERE pl.event_id = ${event}
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT 15

SELECT coalesce(nullif(trim(i.introduction_method), ''), '(not given)') AS introduction_method, count(*) AS count
FROM participant_participation pp
JOIN participant_participationplan pl ON pl.id = pp.plan_id
JOIN participant_participant p ON p.id = pp.participant_id
JOIN participant_participantinfo i ON i.id = coalesce(pp.info_id, p.info_id)
WHERE pl.event_id = ${event}
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT 12

SELECT coalesce(nullif(i.grade, ''), '(not given)') AS grade, count(*) AS count
FROM participant_participation pp
JOIN participant_participationplan pl ON pl.id = pp.plan_id
JOIN participant_participant p ON p.id = pp.participant_id
JOIN participant_participantinfo i ON i.id = coalesce(pp.info_id, p.info_id)
WHERE pl.event_id = ${event}
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT coalesce(nullif(i.gender, ''), '(not given)') AS gender, count(*) AS count
FROM participant_participation pp
JOIN participant_participationplan pl ON pl.id = pp.plan_id
JOIN participant_participant p ON p.id = pp.participant_id
JOIN participant_participantinfo i ON i.id = coalesce(pp.info_id, p.info_id)
WHERE pl.event_id = ${event}
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT coalesce(m.name, '(none)') AS attendance, count(*) AS count
FROM participant_participation pp
JOIN participant_participationplan pl ON pl.id = pp.plan_id
LEFT JOIN participant_modeofattendance m ON m.id = pl.mode_of_attendance_id
WHERE pl.event_id = ${event}
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Codes defined
panels.description: Discount codes that exist for the edition.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM payment_paymentdiscount WHERE event_id = ${event}

panels.title: Codes used
panels.description: Codes redeemed in at least one paid order.

targets.rawSql:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT discount_id, status FROM payment_paymentrequest WHERE discount_id IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT discount_id, status FROM payment_grouppaymentrequest WHERE discount_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT count(DISTINCT d.id)
FROM payment_paymentdiscount d
JOIN r ON r.discount_id = d.id AND r.status = 'paid'
WHERE d.event_id = ${event}

panels.title: Paid redemptions
panels.description: Paid orders that used a discount code.

targets.rawSql:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT discount_id, status FROM payment_paymentrequest WHERE discount_id IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT discount_id, status FROM payment_grouppaymentrequest WHERE discount_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT count(*)
FROM payment_paymentdiscount d
JOIN r ON r.discount_id = d.id
WHERE d.event_id = ${event} AND r.status = 'paid'

WITH r AS (
  SELECT discount_id, status FROM payment_paymentrequest WHERE discount_id IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT discount_id, status FROM payment_grouppaymentrequest WHERE discount_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT count(*)
FROM payment_paymentdiscount d
JOIN r ON r.discount_id = d.id
WHERE d.event_id = ${event} AND r.status = 'pending'

panels.title: Uses left (capped codes)
panels.description: Remaining uses across codes that have a usage cap (unlimited codes are excluded).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT coalesce(sum(count), 0) FROM payment_paymentdiscount
WHERE event_id = ${event} AND count <> -1

panels.title: Unlimited codes
panels.description: Codes with no usage cap.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM payment_paymentdiscount WHERE event_id = ${event} AND count = -1

WITH r AS (
  SELECT discount_id, status FROM payment_paymentrequest WHERE discount_id IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT discount_id, status FROM payment_grouppaymentrequest WHERE discount_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT d.code, count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.status = 'paid') AS count
FROM payment_paymentdiscount d
JOIN r ON r.discount_id = d.id
WHERE d.event_id = ${event}
GROUP BY d.code
HAVING count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.status = 'paid') > 0
ORDER BY count DESC
LIMIT 15

panels.title: Discount codes
panels.description: Every code of the edition: its value (fixed Toman or percentage), remaining uses (∞ = unlimited) and redemptions by order status.

targets.rawSql:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT discount_id, status FROM payment_paymentrequest WHERE discount_id IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT discount_id, status FROM payment_grouppaymentrequest WHERE discount_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT d.code,
  CASE WHEN d.amount > 0 THEN (d.amount / 10) || ' T' ELSE d.percentage || ' %' END AS value,
  CASE WHEN d.count = -1 THEN '∞' ELSE d.count::text END AS uses_left,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.status = 'paid') AS paid,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.status = 'pending') AS pending,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.status = 'failed') AS failed
FROM payment_paymentdiscount d
LEFT JOIN r ON r.discount_id = d.id
WHERE d.event_id = ${event}
GROUP BY d.id
ORDER BY paid DESC, d.code

panels.title: Payment success rate
panels.description: Successful out of all finalized attempts (success + failed + timeout) started in range.

targets.rawSql:
WITH edition_orders AS (
  SELECT pr.order_id AS oid
  FROM payment_paymentrequest pr
  JOIN payment_paymentrequest_plans prp ON prp.paymentrequest_id = pr.id
  JOIN participant_participationplan pl ON pl.id = prp.participationplan_id
  WHERE pl.event_id = ${event}
  GROUP BY pr.order_id
  UNION
  SELECT g.order_id
  FROM payment_grouppaymentrequest g
  JOIN participant_participationplan pl ON pl.id = g.plan_id
  WHERE pl.event_id = ${event}
),
inc AS (
  SELECT p.*
  FROM payment_remote.payments p
  JOIN edition_orders o ON o.oid = p.order_id::text
)
SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE payment_status = 3)
  / nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE payment_status IN (1, 2, 3)), 0), 1) AS rate
FROM inc
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)

  SELECT pr.order_id AS oid
  FROM payment_paymentrequest pr
  JOIN payment_paymentrequest_plans prp ON prp.paymentrequest_id = pr.id
  JOIN participant_participationplan pl ON pl.id = prp.participationplan_id

  sum(discount) / 10 AS "discount given"
FROM inc
